notes: OpenCode 2.x through the service API (#2109 P5b-2). Six file-tool turns on one ses_… session, each ending on its own Stop hook in ready; the session never waits and never leaves the service pid. Exactly six readies — one per turn — so a ready inside a turn (a step-boundary bounce) fails. Each turn start is at least 1s after the previous turn's ready (the record's min_delay rule). Kept small on purpose: three tiny files, a summary, one note, one listing — the brief keeps the shared local model's context small.
